parameters.query:
select bp.profile_id, bp.channel, bp.app_user_id, s.status,
  case when s.status = 'trialing' then 'trial_expiry' else 'churn_grace' end as reason
from bot_profiles bp
join subscribers s using (app_user_id)
where bp.deleted_at is null
  and (
    (s.status = 'trialing' and bp.created_at < now() - interval '4 days 17 hours')
    or (s.status in ('expired','grace') and coalesce(s.current_period_end, now() - interval '99 days') < now() - interval '3 days')
  );

select bp.profile_id, bp.channel, bp.app_user_id
from bot_profiles bp
left join subscribers s on s.app_user_id = bp.app_user_id
where bp.deleted_at is null
  and bp.created_at < now() - interval '1 hour'
  and coalesce(s.status, 'none') <> 'active';

parameters.content:
## Profile Lifecycle Sweep — Task 12 (billing)

**⚠ Sweep Config.dryRun = true UNTIL Task 15 launch — DO NOT flip to false while owner-recreated real bots sit in the registry as trial/trialing. Flipping this live before launch would delete their real Wappi profiles.**

Every 6h. Branch A (top row): Candidates (trial older than 4d17h before Wappi's day-6 retro-charge boundary, OR churned/grace subscribers >3d past period_end) → Trial/Churn Dry Run? → Capture Delete Fields (last safe .item snapshot of profile_id/channel/app_user_id/reason — nothing upstream of it ever collapses) → HTTP Delete Profile → Delete Succeeded? → Mark Deleted (sets deleted_at + deleted_reason, RETURNING so N≥2 successful deletes in one run — e.g. one owner's WhatsApp+Telegram both expiring together — never collapse into one ambiguous item) → Mark Succeeded? → Demote Trialing (only ever demotes trialing, no-op for churn) → Stamp Deleted / Stamp Mark Failed.

Branch B (bottom row, liveness reconcile): List WA/TG Profiles → Alive Registry (excludes status='active' AND anything created <1h ago — the age guard closes a fetch-snapshot race against a just-registered profile) → Compute Liveness Diff (validates each base independently: a fetch error → skip_invalid_fetch; a well-formed but EMPTY live list while the registry holds alive rows for that channel → ALSO skip_invalid_fetch/empty_list_floor — never mass-retire on a suspicious-looking empty response) → Is Retire Candidate? → Liveness Dry Run? → Mark Liveness Deleted (deleted_reason='liveness', no Wappi call — absence from the list IS the evidence).

NEVER touches status='active' owners in either branch. Idempotent: both branches' WHERE clauses only ever select deleted_at IS NULL rows, so a marked row drops out of candidates on the next run. deleted_reason (bot_profiles column) is the durable audit trail — outlives execution-log retention.

parameters.query:
-- V12 (iteration 2026-09-28): clones of bots THIS sweep retired (trial or subscription over) that are not yet
-- confirmed inactive. Never a liveness row (that retirement is inferred from Wappi's list; a false positive must not
-- switch off a working bot), never app_delete (the app deletes its clone), never a workflow a LIVE row still drives,
-- never a protected infra id. clone_deactivated_id holds the workflow last confirmed inactive: a failed call is picked
-- again next run, a deactivated one never. T5: never a row the bot's line superseded — its clone is booked in
-- clone_retirements and branch A deletes it. Read-only; at most 50 per run, oldest retirement first.
select bp.profile_id, bp.workflow_id, bp.deleted_reason
from bot_profiles bp
where bp.deleted_at is not null
  and bp.deleted_reason in ('trial_expiry', 'churn_grace')
  and bp.superseded_by is null
  and bp.workflow_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]+$' and length(bp.workflow_id) between 8 and 36
  and bp.workflow_id not in ('0DP79STI3pafXO9B', '2htWSV5IHO8E2CgB', '2islisFH7jjLoPQM', '3qax5J9u2qsT9Vao', '4VN3gsFaC2HUYmcc', '4wYitz5ek30SVNlT', '9PTyYcelRQI7bGDb', 'KoTuIlk4LMrlvnWI', 'SCLcpn6DMDG3Z4VN', 'TwWPW3gIyjZS3foR', 'Uz6HBBUpAiUqVysB', 'XuvOp7TxOImOAmlj', 'ZGYr6srzS3rSSXHp', 'ZTqpumOpL1rNDOp6', 'crAuthSession001', 'crHandoffDry0001', 'crHandoffNtfy001', 'crHandoffReq0001', 'crHandoffsApi001', 'crPriceSearch001', 'crTestDialog0001', 'crWappiProxy0001', 'fXYpCXPKw92EzRz8', 'hHwvfOvTCS42pXnq', 'jtbssfzXbOxwTK4k', 'lmjYsdNcQA2IE5rl', 'olmqWMfcFpCEcpiE')
  and bp.clone_deactivated_id is distinct from bp.workflow_id
  and not exists (select 1 from bot_profiles live where live.workflow_id = bp.workflow_id and live.deleted_at is null)
order by bp.deleted_at
limit 50;

-- V12: the clone this row is bound to is confirmed inactive (or gone) — remember WHICH one, so it is never called
-- again and a later re-bound clone is still picked. Parameters, in order: profile id, workflow id.
update bot_profiles set clone_deactivated_id = $2
where profile_id = $1 and workflow_id = $2
returning profile_id, workflow_id;

-- F1 (plan 2026-10-11 §1.6, the sweep's branch A): booked clones not yet confirmed gone. Never one a LIVE bot_profiles
-- row drives, never a malformed or protected id, never younger than ten minutes (a Create still in flight). Least tried
-- first, so a clone that keeps failing never starves the rest; at most 50 per run. Read-only.
select r.workflow_id, r.reason, r.attempts from clone_retirements r
where r.removed_at is null
  and r.workflow_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{8,36}$' and r.workflow_id not in ('0DP79STI3pafXO9B', '2htWSV5IHO8E2CgB', '2islisFH7jjLoPQM', '3qax5J9u2qsT9Vao', '4VN3gsFaC2HUYmcc', '4wYitz5ek30SVNlT', '9PTyYcelRQI7bGDb', 'KoTuIlk4LMrlvnWI', 'SCLcpn6DMDG3Z4VN', 'TwWPW3gIyjZS3foR', 'Uz6HBBUpAiUqVysB', 'XuvOp7TxOImOAmlj', 'ZGYr6srzS3rSSXHp', 'ZTqpumOpL1rNDOp6', 'crAuthSession001', 'crHandoffDry0001', 'crHandoffNtfy001', 'crHandoffReq0001', 'crHandoffsApi001', 'crPriceSearch001', 'crTestDialog0001', 'crWappiProxy0001', 'fXYpCXPKw92EzRz8', 'hHwvfOvTCS42pXnq', 'jtbssfzXbOxwTK4k', 'lmjYsdNcQA2IE5rl', 'olmqWMfcFpCEcpiE')
  and r.created_at < now() - interval '10 minutes'
  and not exists (select 1 from bot_profiles live where live.workflow_id = r.workflow_id and live.deleted_at is null)
order by r.attempts, r.created_at, r.workflow_id
limit 50;

-- F1 (plan 2026-10-11 §1.6): the clone answered 200 or 404 to DELETE, it is gone and never picked again.
-- Parameters, in order: workflow id, the HTTP status.
update clone_retirements set removed_at = now(), last_status = $2
where workflow_id = $1 and removed_at is null
returning workflow_id;

-- F1 (plan 2026-10-11 §1.6): the DELETE did not confirm the clone gone; count the attempt, the next run tries again.
-- Parameters, in order: workflow id, the HTTP status (or the error).
update clone_retirements set attempts = attempts + 1, last_status = $2
where workflow_id = $1 and removed_at is null
returning workflow_id, attempts;

-- Learning A retention (180 дней): наборы панели и метки происхождения на строках истории.
-- Строки chat_history_events НЕ удаляются — только их origin_* обнуляются (по origin_kind, чтобы и «none» истекал).
-- Ветка висит прямо на триггере и НЕ подчиняется Sweep Config.dryRun: удаление по возрасту, не по профилю.
with sets as (delete from public.suggestion_sets where created_at < now() - interval '180 days' returning 1),
     origins as (update public.chat_history_events
                   set origin_kind = null, origin_index = null, origin_key = null, origin_edit = null, origin_top1 = null, origin_set = null
                 where origin_kind is not null and created_at < now() - interval '180 days' returning 1)
select (select count(*)::int from sets) as expired_sets, (select count(*)::int from origins) as expired_origins;
